Container, heater and red/blue paths appear.
The red and blue paths are disconnected; labels for rising/sinking do not match the requested left/right circulation.
Intervals remain continuous lines with tick marks rather than 1,2,4,8 segments; remaining lengths 8/9 and 26/27 are incorrect for stages 2 and 3.
Structure names appear in approximately the requested sequence.
A horizontal label chain replaces the U-shaped connected tubule; there is no distinct capillary path or properly grounded exchange arrows.
